evidence_excerpts: Compared with the best alternative, Ansor improves DNN execution performance on Intel CPU, ARM CPU, and NVIDIA GPU by up to 3.8x, 2.6x, and 1.7x, respectively.
text: Ansor improves end-to-end DNN execution performance on Intel CPU, ARM CPU, and NVIDIA GPU by up to 3.8x, 2.6x, and 1.7x relative to the best evaluated alternatives.
